sections.title: One sentence
sections.body: An evidence-backed statement about a subject.

sections.title: In plain language
sections.body: Separate “this is what the document says” from “this must be universally true.”

sections.title: Concrete example
sections.body: A document says a tool is part of an ecosystem; an assertion records that statement and its supporting chunk.

sections.title: In this Knowledge OS
sections.body: Candidate assertion changes enter a Proposal and become canonical only through the approval path.

sections.title: Why it exists
sections.body: Keeping statements separate allows evidence, validity and corrections to remain explainable.

sections.title: Technical detail
sections.body: Assertions have source evidence and temporal bounds. Runtime knowledge status is different from the Explorer’s implementation verification status.

sections.title: Implementation
sections.body: Open the checked implementation, tests, contracts and migrations below. These links identify evidence, not new verification.
